provenance: Verbatim reflector output already produced by the r0002 untreated baseline. No report was written, edited or regenerated for this experiment.
purpose: Frozen craft reports for characterising the discovery grader against the atomic provider-outcome-interpretation column.
selection_rule: One anchor per semantic category named in the atomic-pressure pre-registration, taken verbatim from the retained r0002 baseline and never edited. The three reports the previous non-specific column false-credited are deliberately included, so the set is biased toward difficulty; anchors were chosen before any repeated grading of this column existed, never for observed instability, and no repeated grading had been run.
